title: Check AWS WorkSpaces round-trip latency and session performance
description: Check AWS WorkSpaces round-trip latency and session performance through a read-only diagnosis of the authenticated caller. It uses assignment, WorkSpace state, connection status, CloudWatch InSessionLatency, connection outcomes, CPU, memory, disk, packet loss, retransmission, launch, disconnect, and user-connected telemetry.
effects: inspect Amazon WorkSpaces round-trip latency and recent session performance for ${target_upn}
diagnose slow, freezing, lagging, black-screen, disconnecting, or degraded WorkSpaces sessions without changing AWS or automatically cleaning a Windows endpoint
